hypothesis: A learned map from coordination parameters to actually issued reference can repair the dominant reference-construction error, while retaining the original estimated Human inverse dynamics/allocator as cost structure.

motivation.warning: Post-execution reconstruction is not a forward prediction score and not a causal mediation fraction.

training_inputs: Fixed legal causal context plus 8D modal proposals; completed issued q_ref/dq_ref/ddq_ref histories and original qualification feedback
forbidden_inputs: New candidate future Human truth, new candidate executed reference, future cuff force or new held-out outcomes
model: Fixed-context signed piecewise-linear reference-response basis from zero and +/-0.35 single-mode histories; missing/incomplete directions explicitly infeasible/unknown, no invented full cost.
nominal_cost: Original commissioned estimated Human model and allocator on predicted reference, calibrated only to common strong anchor; quadratic cheap approximation checked with exact nominal arithmetic on shortlist.
selection: Three reference-response-guided proposals plus one same-pool original nominal counterfactual, all predicted and frozen before any of these four native executions.
native_engineering_overhead: New cold parent plus B/H150/strong, counted separately; total new physical START cap8.
primary_algorithm_comparison: Original A/B/C 32-each and scratch PPO remain unchanged. Response branch reports17 prior tasks plus4 new candidate attempts and its separate overhead; no unequal-budget superiority claim.
validation: Freeze model before new native outcomes; test predicted issued reference and full JF/JM on four cases; at most one response-guided qualified action may enter later source/candidate lock. No claimed calibrated motion uncertainty or cross-state policy.
source_control: Separate modules and queue job; never modify running primary sources.
